# Towards Victory — Supplemental on_action hooks
# Generated by scripts/gen_victory_scaffold.py
#
# Primary milestone checking is handled by tv_victory_situation.on_monthly.
# This file provides POINT ACCUMULATION hooks for Diplomatic and Cultural paths,
# tied to specific in-game events.
#
# ── DIPLOMATIC VICTORY POINTS (tv_diplomatic_victory_points) ──────────────────
# +3 DVP: royal marriage (both parties)
# +5 DVP: winning a war (winner)

on_royal_marriage = {
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_points } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points add = 3 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_points } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points add = 3 }
		}
	}
}

on_winning_war = {
	effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_points } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points add = 5 }
		}
	}
}
#
# ── CULTURAL INFLUENCE POINTS (tv_cultural_influence_points) ──────────────────
# +10 CIP when a work of art is created (root.owner = commissioning country)
# Scope chain verified: _hardcoded.txt:4300 — root.owner accesses owning country

on_work_of_art_created = {
	effect = {
		root.owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_cultural_influence_points } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points add = 10 }
		}
	}
}

# +1 CIP/month for all countries (baseline cultural investment proxy)

monthly_country_pulse = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_cultural_influence_points } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points value = 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points add = 1 }
	}
}
#
# ── SCIENTIFIC SCORE (tv_science_score) ──────────────────────────────────────
# Weighted technology count (recomputed in tv_update_all_progress_pct_effect):
#   Age 1-2 technologies: weight x1
#   Age 3 technologies:   weight x2
#   Age 4 technologies:   weight x3
#   Age 5 technologies (steam/industrial): weight x5
#
# TODO: implement scoring formula inside tv_update_all_progress_pct_effect.
